profile.name: Gaurav Singh
profile.title: Software Engineer | AI & Generative AI Engineer
profile.bio: I build intelligent AI-powered applications, scalable backend systems, and production-ready APIs. My work focuses on Generative AI, Agentic AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and backend engineering.
profile.hero_detail: I enjoy transforming complex problems into practical software solutions by combining LLM-powered workflows, intelligent search, modern backend architectures, and database optimization.
about: I'm a Software Engineer specializing in AI-powered applications and backend development. I work with Python, FastAPI, Node.js, and modern Generative AI frameworks to build scalable, intelligent software systems.
My experience includes developing REST APIs, integrating large language models, building RAG pipelines, implementing AI agents, and deploying backend services to cloud platforms.
I've built projects ranging from AI-driven lead discovery and personalized outreach to intelligent document assistants and full-stack local commerce platforms.
Beyond development, I have solved 450+ Data Structures and Algorithms problems and conducted a Generative AI and backend systems workshop attended by 300+ participants.
I'm passionate about building useful products, exploring emerging AI technologies, and developing reliable software that solves real-world problems.

projects.title: ShareMySecret
projects.short_description: Privacy-first encrypted message sharing: AES-GCM encrypted, self-destructing links with zero storage.
projects.description: ShareMySecret lets people share passwords, API keys, and other sensitive information through encrypted, auto-expiring links instead of leaving them in chat or email. I co-founded it and lead it as CTO.
highlights: Messages are encrypted in memory with AES-GCM using a random salt and nonce, and are never written to disk.
Zero storage: there is no database; the encrypted payload is encoded into a URL-safe token that becomes the shareable link.
Links self-destruct after a sender-chosen expiry time; the server checks expiry before decrypting.
Secrets can be shared by copying the link or scanning a QR code.
